historyZH: 巴库于 2016 年以欧洲大奖赛之名加入 F1，次年开始举办阿塞拜疆大奖赛。赛道结合海滨长直道与老城狭窄路段。
historyEN: Baku entered F1 with the 2016 European Grand Prix, followed by the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in 2017. Its layout combines a waterfront straight with narrow old-town streets.
regionZH: 巴库的街道赛让比赛与城市生活紧密相连。当地饮食融合土耳其及中东风味，观赛之余可体验城市餐饮文化。
regionEN: The street race puts visitors close to city life. Local cooking draws on Turkish and Middle Eastern influences.

historyZH: 斯帕最初由城镇间的公路组成，1921 年建成，1979 年改为较短布局。它是 1950 年首届 F1 世界锦标赛的分站之一。
historyEN: Spa began as a public-road course in 1921 and was shortened in 1979. It featured in the inaugural F1 championship in 1950.
regionZH: 赛道位于阿登地区的森林与丘陵之间，自然地形与林地景观是这里鲜明的特色。
regionEN: The Ardennes forests and rolling hills define the circuit’s setting and character.

historyZH: 亨格罗宁于 1985 年动工，约九个月后完工。1986 年首次举办 F1，皮奎特赢得首场比赛。
historyEN: Construction began in 1985 and took about nine months. Nelson Piquet won the first F1 race here in 1986.
regionZH: 赛道距离布达佩斯约 20 公里，方便把观赛与城市历史、餐饮和夜生活结合起来。
regionEN: Around 20 km from Budapest, the circuit offers access to the city’s history, food and nightlife.

historyZH: 银石由军用机场道路发展而来，1947 年开始举办赛车。1950 年 5 月 13 日，这里举行了 F1 世界锦标赛的首场比赛。
historyEN: Silverstone grew from an airfield and hosted racing in 1947. On 13 May 1950 it staged the first Formula 1 World Championship race.
regionZH: 英国深厚的赛车文化与热情的观众，让银石的比赛周末具有鲜明的主场氛围。
regionEN: Britain’s motorsport tradition and enthusiastic spectators give Silverstone its distinctive race-weekend atmosphere.

historyZH: 赛道利用圣劳伦斯河中圣母岛的道路建成。1978 年首次举办 F1，吉尔·维伦纽夫在此取得生涯首胜。
historyEN: Built around roads on Notre Dame Island, the circuit first hosted F1 in 1978, when Gilles Villeneuve earned his first victory.
regionZH: 蒙特利尔在比赛周末充满车迷活动，岛上的绿地则为赛道带来轻松的公园氛围。
regionEN: Montreal embraces the Grand Prix across the city, while the island circuit has a leafy, park-like setting.

historyZH: Madring 在 2026 年首次举办 F1。它与马德里过去使用的哈拉马赛道不同，是更靠近城市的新场地。
historyEN: Madring made its F1 debut in 2026. It is a new, more central venue, distinct from Madrid’s earlier Jarama circuit.
regionZH: 马德里拥有艺术博物馆、街市、露天广场和小吃酒吧。丽池公园等绿地也适合赛后游览。
regionEN: Madrid combines art museums and street markets with open-air squares, tapas bars and parks such as the Retiro.

historyZH: 这片场地的历史可追溯至 1969 年的 Österreichring。1995 至 1996 年改建为较短布局，F1 于 1997 年在当时的 A1-Ring 回归。
historyEN: The venue traces its roots to the 1969 Österreichring. A shorter layout was built in 1995–96, and F1 returned to the A1-Ring in 1997.
regionZH: 赛道坐落在施蒂里亚群山之间的天然盆地中，周边山景是奥地利站的重要特色。
regionEN: The circuit sits in a natural bowl among the Styrian mountains, giving the Austrian round a scenic setting.

historyZH: 现今的大道赛道于 2023 年迎来 F1。拉斯维加斯此前曾在 1981 和 1982 年举办凯撒宫大奖赛，但那是另一条赛道。
historyEN: The current Strip circuit debuted in 2023. Las Vegas previously hosted the 1981 and 1982 Caesars Palace Grands Prix at a different venue.
regionZH: 这里以夜间娱乐和城市灯光著称，比赛将大道景观与周六夜赛的氛围结合起来。
regionEN: The city’s lights and entertainment scene frame a Saturday-night race around the Strip.

historyZH: 上海国际赛车场于 2003 年开始建设，2004 年迎来首届中国大奖赛，巴里切罗代表法拉利获胜。
historyEN: Construction began in 2003. The first Chinese Grand Prix followed in 2004, with Rubens Barrichello winning for Ferrari.
regionZH: 上海融合都市餐饮与丰富的城市生活；地铁 11 号线可到达赛车场，方便把观赛和市区游览结合起来。
regionEN: Shanghai offers a lively food and city scene. Metro Line 11 connects visitors to the circuit.

historyZH: 亚斯码头赛道于 2007 年动工，2009 年完工并首次举办 F1。维特尔赢得首场比赛，并在次年于此夺得首个世界冠军。
historyEN: Work began in 2007 and the circuit opened in 2009. Sebastian Vettel won its first F1 race and secured his first world title here a year later.
regionZH: 亚斯岛将赛车场与主题乐园、海滩、酒店和其他休闲设施结合，是阿布扎比的重要旅游区域。
regionEN: Yas Island brings together the circuit, theme parks, beaches, hotels and leisure attractions near Abu Dhabi.

historyZH: 美洲赛道于 2012 年正式启用，同年迎来 F1。汉密尔顿在首届比赛获胜，这是他效力迈凯伦期间的最后一场胜利。
historyEN: COTA opened in 2012 and hosted F1 that year. Lewis Hamilton won the inaugural race, his final victory for McLaren.
regionZH: 奥斯汀以餐饮、夜生活和鲜明的城市个性吸引访客，适合把比赛周末与城市体验结合。
regionEN: Austin’s food, nightlife and distinctive local character complement a visit to the race.

historyZH: 雪邦于 1997 年动工、1999 年启用，由赫尔曼·蒂尔克设计。首届马来西亚大奖赛由埃迪·埃尔文获胜。
historyEN: Designed by Hermann Tilke, Sepang was built from 1997 and opened in 1999. Eddie Irvine won its first Malaysian Grand Prix.
regionZH: 雪邦靠近吉隆坡国际机场。观赛之余可体验马来西亚的多元文化和饮食，并前往吉隆坡游览。
regionEN: Sepang is close to Kuala Lumpur International Airport. Visitors can explore Malaysian food and culture and spend time in Kuala Lumpur.

historyZH: 墨尔本在 1993 年确定引入 F1，赛道利用阿尔伯特公园周边道路建成。1996 年首次接替阿德莱德举办澳大利亚大奖赛。
historyEN: Melbourne agreed to host F1 in 1993, using roads around Albert Park. Its first Australian Grand Prix took place in 1996 after Adelaide’s final race.
regionZH: 墨尔本有丰富的餐厅、酒吧和海滨休闲空间，比赛通常处于澳大利亚的初秋。
regionEN: Melbourne combines restaurants and bars with nearby beaches. Its Grand Prix typically falls in early Australian autumn.

historyZH: 蒙扎于 1922 年建成，同年举办意大利大奖赛。它自 1950 年起便是 F1 世界锦标赛的重要传统场地。
historyEN: Monza opened in 1922 and hosted the Italian Grand Prix that year. It has been a major F1 venue since the championship began in 1950.
regionZH: 赛道位于米兰东北方向的公园中。林地与保留下来的旧倾斜弯道，让现代比赛与赛车历史交织。
regionEN: Northeast of Milan, Monza’s parkland and surviving historic banking connect the modern race with its past.

historyZH: 迈阿密国际赛道围绕硬石体育场布置，2022 年首次举办 F1。设计过程评估了多种路线，最终采用 19 个弯的布局。
historyEN: Built around Hard Rock Stadium, Miami’s circuit debuted in F1 in 2022. Its final layout has 19 corners after numerous design studies.
regionZH: 迈阿密以海滩、装饰艺术建筑和多元文化闻名，城市的体育与娱乐氛围延伸到比赛周末。
regionEN: Miami is known for beaches, Art Deco character and cultural diversity, alongside a strong sporting and entertainment scene.

historyZH: 赞德沃特于 1948 年开放，1952 年首次举办 F1。赛事在长期离开后于 2021 年重返这里。
historyEN: Zandvoort opened in 1948 and first hosted F1 in 1952. The championship returned in 2021 after a long absence.
regionZH: 赛道位于海滨沙丘地带，从阿姆斯特丹乘火车可到附近。看台上鲜明的橙色也是荷兰站的特色。
regionEN: The circuit lies among seaside dunes within reach of Amsterdam by train. Orange-filled stands are a hallmark of the Dutch round.

historyZH: 赛道作为巴塞罗那奥运相关建设的一部分，于 1989 年奠基、1991 年开始办赛。同年 F1 首次到访，曼塞尔夺冠。
historyEN: Developed alongside Barcelona’s Olympic preparations, the circuit began construction in 1989 and hosted F1 in 1991, with Nigel Mansell winning.
regionZH: 巴塞罗那将美食、文化与海滩结合，为比赛之外的城市游览提供丰富选择。
regionEN: Barcelona combines food, culture and beaches for a varied trip beyond the race.

historyZH: 滨海湾赛道于 2008 年首次举办 F1，也是世界锦标赛历史上的首场夜赛举办地。路线穿行于城市地标之间。
historyEN: Marina Bay debuted in 2008 with the first night race in F1 World Championship history, taking the cars through the city.
regionZH: 新加坡摩天观景轮可俯瞰赛道周边，市区的餐厅和历史酒店则提供丰富的赛后体验。
regionEN: The Singapore Flyer overlooks the circuit area, while restaurants and historic hotels offer places to explore after racing.

historyZH: 赛道于 1959 年建成，1962 年举办非锦标赛 F1 赛事，1963 年加入世界锦标赛。墨西哥站于 2015 年重返赛历。
historyEN: Built in 1959, the circuit held a non-championship F1 race in 1962 and joined the championship in 1963. Mexico returned to the calendar in 2015.
regionZH: 赛道位于墨西哥城东侧，附近有地铁，方便在赛事与城市文化体验之间往返。
regionEN: Located east of central Mexico City, the circuit has nearby metro access for combining racing with city culture.

historyZH: 卢赛尔最初为 2004 年的 MotoGP 赛事而建。2021 年首次举办 F1，随后成为长期举办场地。
historyEN: Lusail was built for Qatar’s 2004 MotoGP race. F1 first visited in 2021 before a longer-term hosting agreement.
regionZH: 赛道位于多哈郊外。官网推荐当地户外活动，包括沙漠游览与赛道卡丁车体验。
regionEN: Outside Doha, the venue is a base for outdoor experiences such as desert excursions and karting.

historyZH: 英特拉格斯于 1938 年开始建设，1973 年首次举办 F1 世界锦标赛。菲蒂帕尔迪赢得前两届比赛，帕塞于 1975 年获胜。
historyEN: Construction began in 1938. Interlagos first hosted a championship Grand Prix in 1973; Emerson Fittipaldi won the first two, followed by Carlos Pace in 1975.
regionZH: 巴西站的观众文化充满节庆气氛，现场热情是体验圣保罗比赛周末的重要部分。
regionEN: Brazil’s festive fan culture gives the São Paulo race weekend a particularly enthusiastic atmosphere.

historyZH: 铃鹿于 1962 年作为本田测试赛道建成，由约翰·胡根霍尔茨设计。1987 年首次举办 F1，立体交叉路线成为标志。
historyEN: Designed by John Hugenholtz, Suzuka opened as a Honda test track in 1962. Its distinctive crossover layout first hosted F1 in 1987.
regionZH: 铃鹿以热情且富有创意的车迷、摩天轮和当地美食，为日本站带来独特的观赛体验。
regionEN: Creative, committed fans, a Ferris wheel and local food give the Japanese round a distinctive spectator experience.

historyZH: 摩纳哥街道赛始于 1929 年，并在 1950 年列入首届 F1 世界锦标赛。城市道路与狭窄弯道塑造了它的传统特色。
historyEN: Monaco’s street race began in 1929 and joined the inaugural F1 championship in 1950. Tight city streets define its character.
regionZH: 摩纳哥的比赛融入蔚蓝海岸的城市生活；比赛结束后，可以步行感受平日道路与赛道之间的变化。
regionEN: The race is woven into life on the Riviera. After track activity, visitors can explore streets that double as the circuit.

historyZH: 巴林国际赛道于 2002 年动工，2004 年首次举办 F1。迈克尔·舒马赫赢得首场比赛，巴里切罗帮助法拉利包揽前两名。
historyEN: Construction began in 2002, and Bahrain first hosted F1 in 2004. Michael Schumacher won the inaugural race ahead of Ferrari team mate Rubens Barrichello.
regionZH: 官网介绍推荐结合赛事体验巴林的海湾环境，赛道旁也设有卡丁车设施。
regionEN: The official guide highlights Bahrain’s Gulf setting and the karting facility beside the circuit.

historyZH: 吉达滨海赛道于 2021 年首次举办 F1，以高速弯道与夜间比赛著称。
historyEN: Jeddah’s Corniche circuit first hosted F1 in 2021, combining fast corners with racing under lights.
regionZH: 赛道坐落在吉达的红海滨海区域，海岸风景是这里的显著特色。
regionEN: The circuit lies on Jeddah’s Red Sea waterfront, with a coastal setting central to its identity.

historyZH: 伊莫拉在 1953 年启用，1980 年首次举办 F1 世界锦标赛分站，此后长期承办圣马力诺大奖赛。
historyEN: Imola opened in 1953 and first hosted a championship Grand Prix in 1980, later becoming the long-standing home of the San Marino race.
regionZH: 赛道位于意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区，周边有深厚的汽车文化与丰富的地方美食。
regionEN: In Emilia-Romagna, Imola is surrounded by Italy’s automotive heritage and regional food traditions.
